g.text: Booking the token grants access to.
EMD that paid for the service.
System that created the record, e.g. 1A or a carrier code.
Ticket an e-ticket / EMD receipt belongs to.
Event type, e.g. booking.created, booking.ticketed, booking.synced, booking.schedule_changed.
Amadeus segment id (referenced by tickets, remarks, services).
Departure instant (UTC, via airport time zone).
Branded fare (fare family) name, e.g. LIGHTONE.
Document number prefixed by the airline accounting code.
New document when this one was EXCHANGED.
Amadeus traveler id in the order ('1', '2' ...).
Amadeus environment of the flight order.
Velexis booking reference shown to customers (lookup with last name).
Customer (NULL = guest booking, accessed with booking tokens).
Checkout that produced the booking (one booking per checkout).
originSystemCode of the main record, e.g. 1A.
Absolute ticketing deadline (lastTicketingDate / ticketingAgreement in office time zone).
Issuance state (API IssuanceStatus); failed = retried by the issuance job until the deadline.
Last segment arrival (UTC) - a trip is past once this is over.
How the selling price was set (console create/import may sell at net or at an override).
Markup rule applied (pricing_mode = markup_rules; NULL for net / override or a deleted rule).
Amadeus grandTotal incl. booked services (net cost).
Selling total paid by the customer.
Primary contact e-mail (guest lookup and notifications).
Latest Amadeus flight-order data after the redaction rule (document, discount card and certi...
Last refresh from Flight Order Management GET.
Traveller (NULL = all travellers when bookable per order).
Request text as entered (Amadeus remark character set; upper-cased and prefixed when sent).
Order of the request (at most 5 per checkout).
Saved traveller it was prefilled from.
travelerId of the priced offer travelerPricings ('1', '2' ...).
Started as a guest (kept even if the customer is later erased).
Priced offer the checkout was opened with, without ancillaries (ancillary catalogue of setAn...
Priced offer being bought now (= base, or the ancillary / re-price child); kept while the ch...
Terms / privacy policy version (storefront legal versions); NULL for marketing.
Object-storage key of the ZIP (tenant prefix, SSE-KMS); NULL until ready, file deleted at ex...
When the file is deleted (ready_at + 7 days).
Subject at the provider (lower-cased e-mail for password, OIDC sub otherwise); rewritten whe...
SHA-256 of the pending e-mail verification token (sign-up address or customers.pending_email).
When the identity was disabled (account.delete, staff); a disabled identity cannot sign in a...
Session id (ses_ + ULID), also carried as sid in the access token.
SHA-256 of the opaque refresh token.
Rotation family; presenting an already rotated token revokes the whole family.
Token that replaced this one at rotation.
rememberMe at sign-in (copied on rotation): 30-day instead of 12-hour family lifetime.
Absolute end of the family (sign-in + 30 d or 12 h); rotation never extends it.
Login and contact e-mail (unique case-insensitively). account.delete replaces it with '<HMAC...
What the fee is charged for.
Matching criteria (same shape as markup_rules.scope, plus cardBrands for payment_card).
How the offer entered the cache.
Upsell call that returned it (FK added below, circular with offer_upsells).
Amadeus flight-offer id within its response, e.g. '1'.
Price shown to the customer (net + markup).
Marketing carriers of all segments (carriers filter: contained in the requested list; facets).
First segment departure (local time, as Amadeus gives it; departure sort).
Amadeus environment used (from the API key).
simple = Velexis criteria (GET-style), advanced = full Amadeus POST body.
Normalised Velexis search criteria as received.
When the cached results expire (SEARCH_EXPIRED afterwards).
Principal + environment + operation, e.g. live:key_123:checkouts.create or live:cus_9:bookin...
SHA-256 of the canonical request body (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED on mismatch).
Rule name shown in the console.
Matching criteria: {origins, destinations, originCountries, destinationCountries, carriers,...
Evaluation order (lower first); first matching non-stackable rule wins.
Event key, e.g. booking.confirmed, booking.ticketed, auth.verify_email, auth.password_reset.
Template key (kept if the template is deleted).
E-mail address or E.164 phone number.
Booking paid (set when the booking exists; post-booking changes too).
Base priced offer this one re-prices with ancillaries (checkout.setAncillaries); NULL for a...
Verbatim pricing response: data.flightOffers, bookingRequirements, included{credit-card-fees...
Total to pay before ancillaries (net + markup + fees).
Given name as on the travel document (Amadeus name.firstName).
Date of birth (drives the traveler type).
Migration version, e.g. 0001_baseline (lexicographic order = apply order).
stf_ (= staff_id) or key_ (platform.api_keys) id by value; NULL for system and unidentified...
platform.tenant_memberships id, by value (NULL for API-key and system actions and failed sig...
Action, e.g. booking.cancel, order.patch, booking.issue, pnr.lookup, queue.list.
Fixed id: guarantees exactly one row per tenant.
Brand shown in the storefront and e-mails.
When tickets are issued (issue=true at create-order, after capture, or by staff).
True when tickets are issued automatically (derived from ticketing_policy).
Velexis use case / SDK method, e.g. bookings.create.
True when PII/card data were stripped from the bodies.
